data.name: Aaniya
data.gender_notes: Aaniya is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Captive; subdued; subservient (for the spelling عانية)
data.long_meaning: The spelling عانية (ʿāniya) is the active participle of the Arabic root ع-ن-و (ʿ-n-w), 'to be subdued, to submit'. The different spelling آنية (āniya) is a separate word meaning 'vessel, container'. The two spellings must not be merged. Its root is ع-ن-و (ʿ-n-w). Aaniya is a Arabic name meaning “Captive; subdued; subservient (for the spelling عانية)”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aaniya expresses “Captive; subdued; subservient (for the spelling عانية)”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: The spelling عانية (ʿāniya) is the active participle of the Arabic root ع-ن-و (ʿ-n-w), 'to be subdued, to submit'. The different spelling آنية (āniya) is a separate word meaning 'vessel, container'. The two spellings must not be merged.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaniya total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
